text:
The text contains sarcasm in the first two sentences. The speaker claims to "love" when their phone dies during an important call and calls it the "best feature of modern technology." Since phone battery failure during critical moments is universally frustrating and inconvenient, the positive language is used ironically to express strong annoyance and frustration. This sarcasm flips the apparent positive sentiment to a strongly negative one.

The Amazon Rainforest is located in South America.
